messages:
Maria: Heads up — FinOps dash shows a big per-route cost spike for /chat-stream (eu-west1) overnight. 3.2x baseline. Anyone else seeing this?
FinOps-bot: Alert: route /chat-stream exceeded expected cost by 220% on 2026-11-02. Snapshot: https://finops.internal/snap/1820123456 :rotating_light:
Oleg: Can you paste the per-model breakdown? Suspect fallback to on-demand instances (reserved pool exhaustion).
Maria: Quick snapshot from billing: model=gpt-medium-q4 had ~90% fallbacks to on-demand between 02:00-03:30 UTC. Reserved coverage dropped to ~18% at 02:15.
Samir: Is that the pool we resized last week (eu-west1-a100-dedicated)? We scaled down to free budget.
Ashley: I ran a short query — looks like reserved utilization dipped exactly when a rollout spiked avg sequence length. Query I used: ```
SELECT hour, route, model, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM finops_billing
WHERE date='2026-11-02' AND route='/chat-stream'
GROUP BY hour, route, model
ORDER BY hour;
```
Infra-oncall: We had a rolling kernel patch in eu-west1 at 01:58 UTC — autoscaler removed 3 nodes from the dedicated pool to drain for restart (INC-4521). That coincides with the drop.
Oleg: That fits. Drain + no warm standby = reserved pool effectively 0 so traffic fell back to on-demand. Need policy to avoid draining below a reserved floor.
Maria: Actionables: 1) Autoscaler: enforce min_reserved_percentage for dedicated pools. 2) For tonight's window, temporarily increase reserved capacity or pre-warm nodes. 3) Dashboard: add reserved-coverage ratio per pool and alert.
Samir: I'll push a canary change to autoscaler to respect `min_reserved_percentage=30%` in staging and add a synthetic load that mimics long seq lengths.
Ashley: Finance: quick back-of-envelope on incremental cost from failover = ~€1.8k overnight (per-token burn +60%). I'll attach calc sheet.
FinOps-bot: Saved snapshot to /incidents/INC-4521/finops-snap-1820123456.png and archived billing histogram.
Maria: :thumbsup: Please add a short postmortem and tag @billing@redwood. Also evaluate if cross-region routing to eu-central1 (where reserved coverage is healthy) would have avoided on-demand.
Infra-oncall: We can enable temporary routing policy to prefer eu-central1 for /chat-stream until pool recovers. Will coordinate with netops and deployments.
Ashley: I'll update dashboard panels now and add an alert: "reserved_coverage < 40% for > 10m" to page in.
Oleg: Also recommend a monthly commit-coverage audit across regions so reserved capacity doesn't drift away from traffic patterns.
Maria: Thanks team. I'll open a short RFC for autoscaler gating + finops alerting and link the costs calc. We should treat this as a runbook item for nightly rollouts.
